SELECT [s].[TechnicianId], [s].[Name], COALESCE(SUM(CASE
    WHEN [s].[Classification] = N'Rate' THEN [s].[BilledHours]
    ELSE 0.0
END), 0.0) AS [Billed], COALESCE(SUM(CASE
    WHEN [s].[Classification] = N'Covered' THEN [s].[Hours]
    ELSE 0.0
END), 0.0) AS [Covered], COALESCE(SUM(CASE
    WHEN [s].[Classification] = N'HourBank' THEN [s].[Hours]
    ELSE 0.0
END), 0.0) AS [Bank], COALESCE(SUM(CASE
    WHEN [s].[Classification] = N'NonBillable' THEN [s].[Hours]
    ELSE 0.0
END), 0.0) AS [NonBillable]
FROM (
    SELECT [t].[BilledHours], [t].[Classification], [t].[Hours], [t1].[TechnicianId], COALESCE([t1].[TechnicianName], N'—') COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 AS [Name], DATALENGTH(COALESCE([t1].[TechnicianName], N'—')) AS [NameLength]
    FROM [time].[TimeAllocations] AS [t]
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT [t0].[Id], [t0].[TechnicianId], [t0].[TechnicianName], [t0].[WorkDate]
        FROM [time].[TimeEntries] AS [t0]
        WHERE [t0].[IsDeleted] = CAST(0 AS bit)
    ) AS [t1] ON [t].[TimeEntryId] = [t1].[Id]
    WHERE [t].[IsDeleted] = CAST(0 AS bit) AND [t1].[WorkDate] >= @monthStart AND [t1].[WorkDate] <= @monthEnd
) AS [s]
GROUP BY [s].[TechnicianId], [s].[Name], [s].[Nam

SELECT [t1].[Id], [t1].[AfterHours], [t1].[Amount], [t1].[ApprovalCount], [t1].[ApprovedAt], [t1].[ApprovedBy], [t1].[Billable], [t1].[ContractId], [t1].[CreatedAt], [t1].[CreatedBy], [t1].[Description], [t1].[EndedAt], [t1].[ExternalId], [t1].[ExternalTicketId], [t1].[Hours], [t1].[IsDeleted], [t1].[ModifiedAt], [t1].[ModifiedBy], [t1].[Onsite], [t1].[OrganizationId], [t1].[ProjectId], [t1].[ReviewNote], [t1].[RowVersion], [t1].[Source], [t1].[StartedAt], [t1].[Status], [t1].[TechnicianExternalId], [t1].[TechnicianId], [t1].[TechnicianName], [t1].[TicketId], [t1].[TicketTitle], [t1].[WorkDate], [t1].[WorkType], [t2].[Id], [t2].[Amount], [t2].[BilledHours], [t2].[Classification], [t2].[CreatedAt], [t2].[CreatedBy], [t2].[HourBankId], [t2].[Hours], [t2].[IsDeleted], [t2].[ModifiedAt], [t2].[ModifiedBy], [t2].[Rate], [t2].[RowVersion], [t2].[TimeEntryId]
FROM (
    SELECT TOP(@p) [t].[Id], [t].[AfterHours], [t].[Amount], [t].[ApprovalCount], [t].[ApprovedAt], [t].[ApprovedBy], [t].[Billable], [t].[ContractId], [t].[CreatedAt], [t].[CreatedBy], [t].[Description], [t].[EndedAt], [t].[ExternalId], [t].[ExternalTicketId], [t].[Hours], [t].[IsDeleted], [t].[ModifiedAt], [t].[ModifiedBy],

SELECT TOP(2) COUNT(*) AS [Count], COALESCE(SUM([t0].[Hours]), 0.0) AS [Hours], COALESCE(SUM(CASE
    WHEN [t0].[Billable] = CAST(1 AS bit) THEN [t0].[Hours]
    ELSE 0.0
END), 0.0) AS [Billable], COALESCE(SUM(CASE
    WHEN [t0].[Status] IN (N'Approved', N'Invoiced') THEN [t0].[Hours]
    ELSE 0.0
END), 0.0) AS [Approved], COALESCE(SUM(CASE
    WHEN [t0].[Status] = N'New' THEN [t0].[Hours]
    ELSE 0.0
END), 0.0) AS [New], COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE([t0].[Amount], 0.0)), 0.0) AS [Amount]
FROM (
    SELECT [t].[Amount], [t].[Billable], [t].[Hours], [t].[Status], 1 AS [Key]
    FROM [time].[TimeEntries] AS [t]
    WHERE [t].[IsDeleted] = CAST(0 AS bit) AND [t].[WorkDate] >= @from AND [t].[WorkDate] < @to
) AS [t0]
GROUP BY [t0].[Key]

SELECT TOP(2) COUNT(*) AS [Open], COUNT(CASE
    WHEN [t0].[TechnicianUserId] IS NULL THEN 1
END) AS [Unassigned]
FROM (
    SELECT [t].[TechnicianUserId], 1 AS [Key]
    FROM [service].[Tickets] AS [t]
    WHERE [t].[IsOpen] = CAST(1 AS bit)
) AS [t0]
GROUP BY [t0].[Key]

SELECT TOP(@p) [c].[Id], [c].[FirstName], [c].[LastName], [c].[Email], (
    SELECT TOP(1) [o1].[Name]
    FROM [customers].[OrganizationContacts] AS [o]
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT [o0].[Id], [o0].[Name]
        FROM [customers].[Organizations] AS [o0]
        WHERE [o0].[IsDeleted] = CAST(0 AS bit)
    ) AS [o1] ON [o].[OrganizationId] = [o1].[Id]
    WHERE [o].[IsDeleted] = CAST(0 AS bit) AND [o].[ContactId] = [c].[Id] AND [o].[IsActive] = CAST(1 AS bit)
    ORDER BY [o].[IsPrimary] DESC) AS [Organization]
FROM [customers].[Contacts] AS [c]
WHERE [c].[IsDeleted] = CAST(0 AS bit) AND ([c].[FirstName] LIKE @word_contains ESCAPE N'\' OR [c].[LastName] LIKE @word_contains ESCAPE N'\' OR ([c].[Email] IS NOT NULL AND [c].[Email] LIKE @word_contains0 ESCAPE N'\')) AND ([c].[FirstName] LIKE @word3_contains ESCAPE N'\' OR [c].[LastName] LIKE @word3_contains ESCAPE N'\' OR ([c].[Email] IS NOT NULL AND [c].[Email] LIKE @word3_contains0 ESCAPE N'\'))
ORDER BY [c].[LastName], [c].[FirstName]

SELECT MAX([t].[SyncedAt])
FROM [service].[Tickets] AS [t]
WHERE [t].[OrganizationId] = @organizationId

SELECT TOP(@p) [o].[Id], [o].[Name], [o].[OrgNumber], [o].[VisitAddress_City] AS [VisitCity], [o].[PostalAddress_City] AS [PostalCity]
FROM [customers].[Organizations] AS [o]
WHERE [o].[IsDeleted] = CAST(0 AS bit) AND ([o].[Name] LIKE @word_contains ESCAPE N'\' OR ([o].[Email] IS NOT NULL AND [o].[Email] LIKE @word_contains ESCAPE N'\') OR @domain IN (
    SELECT [d].[value]
    FROM OPENJSON([o].[Domains]) WITH ([value] nvarchar(max) '$') AS [d]
)) AND ([o].[Name] LIKE @word3_contains ESCAPE N'\' OR ([o].[Email] IS NOT NULL AND [o].[Email] LIKE @word3_contains ESCAPE N'\') OR @domain5 IN (
    SELECT [d0].[value]
    FROM OPENJSON([o].[Domains]) WITH ([value] nvarchar(max) '$') AS [d0]
))
ORDER BY CASE
    WHEN [o].[Name] LIKE @term_Text_startswith ESCAPE N'\' THEN 0
    ELSE 1
END, [o].[Name]

SELECT [s].[Year], [s].[Month], [s].[ProductId], COALESCE(SUM([s].[LineTotal]), 0.0) AS [LineTotal]
FROM (
    SELECT [b].[LineTotal], [b].[ProductId], DATEPART(year, [b3].[PeriodStart]) AS [Year], DATEPART(month, [b3].[PeriodStart]) AS [Month]
    FROM [billing].[BillingLines] AS [b]
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT [b0].[Id], [b0].[RunId], [b0].[Status]
        FROM [billing].[BillingBases] AS [b0]
        WHERE [b0].[IsDeleted] = CAST(0 AS bit)
    ) AS [b1] ON [b].[BasisId] = [b1].[Id]
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT [b2].[Id], [b2].[PeriodStart]
        FROM [billing].[BillingRuns] AS [b2]
        WHERE [b2].[IsDeleted] = CAST(0 AS bit)
    ) AS [b3] ON [b1].[RunId] = [b3].[Id]
    WHERE [b].[IsDeleted] = CAST(0 AS bit) AND [b3].[PeriodStart] >= @firstPeriod AND [b3].[PeriodStart] <= @lastPeriod AND [b1].[Status] <> N'Cancelled' AND [b].[Group] <> N'Info' AND [b].[Decision] <> N'Exclusion'
) AS [s]
GROUP BY [s].[Year], [s].[Month], [s].[ProductId]
